summary: Game crashes when player model is rendered after the player is stung by a bee
description: The bug When getting stung by a bee, the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered. To reproduce There are multiple ways to reproduce this issue: Inventory - Get stung by a bee - Open your inventory Third-person camera - Enable third-person camera - Get stung by a bee Crash report 19w39a : [ crash-2019-09-27_13.19.08-client.txt] Description: Rendering entity in world java.lang.IllegalStateException: Not filled all elements of the vertex at cxk.a(SourceFile:253) at dwx.a(SourceFile:56) at dyd.a(SourceFile:48) at dyd.a(SourceFile:14) at duw.a(SourceFile:138) at dym.a(SourceFile:64) at dym.a(SourceFile:41) at dtz.a(SourceFile:268) at dtz.a(SourceFile:253) at dgt.a(SourceFile:134) at dgt.a(SourceFile:106) at dfx.render(SourceFile:82) at dgm.render(SourceFile:42) at dgt.render(SourceFile:86) at dpo.a(SourceFile:603) at dat.d(SourceFile:931) at dat.b(SourceFile:569) at net.minecraft.client.main.Main.main(SourceFile:199)
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Use the `/summon bee ~ ~ ~` command to spawn a bee nearby.
3. Allow the bee to sting you (you will take damage and receive poison).
4. Observe that the game crashes as soon as your player model is rendered.

Alternative method:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Use the `/summon bee ~ ~ ~` command to spawn a bee nearby.
3. Allow the bee to sting you (you will take damage and receive poison).
4. Open your inventory by pressing E.
5. Observe that the game crashes as soon as your player model is rendered.

Alternative method:
1. Create a new Creative world with default settings.
2. Press F5 to enable third-person camera view.
3. Use the `/summon bee ~ ~ ~` command to spawn a bee nearby.
4. Allow the bee to sting you (you will take damage and receive poison).
5. Observe that the game crashes as soon as your player model is rendered.
Observed Behavior: When the player gets stung by a bee, the game crashes as soon as the player model is rendered. This issue can be reproduced in several ways: opening the inventory after getting stung or enabling third-person camera mode before being stung. The crash report from version 19w39a indicates an exception during rendering, specifically a `java.lang.IllegalStateException` with the message "Not filled all elements of the vertex." This error occurs at various points in the rendering process, as detailed in the stack trace provided. These details suggest that there is a problem with the player model's vertices not being fully populated when the game attempts to render it after the bee sting event.
Expected Behavior: When the player gets stung by a bee, the game should not crash under any circumstances. Opening the inventory or switching to third-person camera after being stung should function normally without causing any rendering issues or crashes. The player model should render correctly in all scenarios post-sting.
